summary: Second revision after verifier return. Force and COP conventions and the sheet fixes stand as previously verified. Pelvis remedy re-tested at the stride level in every sampled mode (right-stride means, 120-600 samples, each stride centred). The source pelvis angles are Z-X-Y rotations (markers reproduce rotation within 0.5-1.3 deg RMS and tilt/list within 0.9-2.7 deg). The adapter's pelvis_sagittal = pelvis_tilt is wrong. No source-derived forward tilt validates at the stride level on treadmill. The heading-removed source tilt equals -pelvis_list there (sample r 0.989, 0.991), and its stride-mean r with marker tilt is 0.07 and -0.25. Overground it is partial: stride-mean r is levelground 0.46/0.38, ramp 0.57/0.30 and stair 0.79/0.81, from 8-13 mixed strides and amplitudes of 2-5 deg. The earlier sample-level r (0.54-0.97) is withdrawn as support for a remedy. Pelvis and the inherited thigh/shank/foot/trunk sagittal angles stay source-only/unresolved. D-GT21-C01-2 is revised accordingly. The treadmill panel is now in the figure.
checks: Publisher scripts re-read. Citations corrected: C3DtoMOT 74, 83-85 and createExternalLoads 91-96. Added C3DtoMOT 24, 44-45, 58-78 and 98: only the local Fz/Mx/My used for COP are filtered (default 15 Hz, filtfilt). Local COP is set to the plate origin when local Fz > -10 N. The exported F and M are unfiltered btk global wrenches. The adapter's 0.2 BW mask removes those COP samples.

Pelvis composition test on all 8 sampled recordings (2 per mode). Marker frame: x = mean ASIS - mean PSIS, z = R - L ASIS orthogonalized. One constant Procrustes offset was fitted against Rz(tilt) Rx(list) Ry(rotation) from source IK, then decomposed in the same order. Wrapped, median-centred RMS: rotation 0.47-1.33 deg, tilt 0.9-2.7 deg, list 0.85-1.67 deg. Without the offset, tilt and list disagreed on overground recordings (list RMS 14-17 deg), because the marker-to-model offset projects with a heading-dependent sign. A 3-parameter constant fit cannot create time-varying agreement or choose a sign.

Sheets rebuilt. Neutral option order is stated in the builder: most sideways values published first, ties broken by less adapter work. The recommended option is now last (C). The chip that repeated the recommendation's reasoning was removed. 'Cost: none' became 'Adapter work: rename columns'. The X-direction diagram was split into +X (forward) and -X (backward) panels. Every figure is one panel per PNG, at most 4.5 in wide, with fonts of at least 10 pt. Task and decision IDs moved out of the titles and decision heading into the folded details. Heading shares now show one decimal. The COP contrast is now a made-up camera-axes read-back rather than the other foot. The pelvis figure is a seeded random 6 s window (AB14 levelground cw_fast_01_03, start 50.504 s) from a random overground recording.
Rendered at 1100 px and in a 390 px iframe wrapper with headless Chrome, and inspected both. The 1100 px decision table is no longer clipped, and the cards reflow at 390 px.

Builder run: 8 recordings, 0 reader rejections. MemAvailable was at least 1 GiB before each read. Peak RSS was 293 MB (including Python, matplotlib and scipy); the largest single source table is about 11 MB. Runtime about 20 s, under nice 19 and ionice -c 3.
python3 contributor_tools/build_backlog_page.py --check: Backlog valid; HTML current (78 tasks).

Stride-level pelvis test on all 8 sampled recordings. Stride-mean r with marker forward tilt (pelvis_tilt / -pelvis_list / heading-removed source tilt): treadmill AB08 0.03/-0.04/0.07 and AB06 0.71/-0.23/-0.25; levelground AB16 0.40/-0.34/0.46 and AB14 -0.66/0.28/0.38; ramp AB24 0.21/0.54/0.57 and AB06 -0.11/-0.35/0.30; stair AB10 -0.12/0.08/0.79 and AB07 0.47/0.09/0.81. Median within-stride r for heading-removed tilt: treadmill 0.55/0.20, levelground 0.68/0.73, ramp 0.90/0.65, stair 0.94/0.95. Sample-level r between heading-removed tilt and -pelvis_list: treadmill 0.989/0.991.
Publisher IK setups (AB06, AB08, AB14, AB24) apply all four ASIS/PSIS markers, so the treadmill disagreement is not from a missing pelvis marker. It is otherwise unexplained.

Figure 3 now shows two stride-mean panels: a seeded random treadmill recording (AB08 treadmill_03_01, 124 strides) and a seeded random overground recording (AB16 levelground ccw_normal_01_05, 13 strides). Rendered at 1100 px and in a 390 px iframe and inspected. The moment-reference item moved from a chip to 'not shown' to keep 8 chips.
remaining: D-GT21-C01-1 (sideways force/COP) and D-GT21-C01-2 (pelvis/segment tilt handling) need José.

Explain the treadmill marker vs IK pelvis-tilt disagreement before any source-derived tilt is proposed again. Candidates are marker noise, soft tissue or IK weighting; this needs a guarded native model check of model-marker residuals. Overground evidence is only 2 recordings per mode, with mixed ascent/descent strides.

Joint-angle zero (publisher ik_offset static-pose zero vs ik model zero) remains an open convention, queued as a decision once a slot frees. Version-1 archives (AB17) lack ik_offset/static, and the restricted reader rejects the 2024 static/ik_offset layout, so offsets are unquantified.
Anterior force/COP take lab Z only. Z-dominant cycles allow up to 45 deg heading (sampled 95th percentile 8-36 deg), so values are under-projected on curved levelground segments.
Plate moment reference point and sign (hundreds of N m on contact, so not free moments; not exported; unused by publisher ID). Combined virtual plate composition.
COP origin is the lateral ankle marker, not the ankle joint centre; the offset is not quantified.

No producer log ties the shipped C3DtoMOT/C3DtoTRC to the published files, and the btk force-sign convention is not stated. The frame and force-on-body are corroborated by data and by publisher ID usage.
BW normalization depends on the unresolved SubjectInfo.Weight unit (GT21-A02/S01).
Sample covers 8 recordings from 7 participants; AB17 not examined.
next_action: After José answers, update the adapter: sideways columns per D-GT21-C01-1. Leave the pelvis/thigh/shank/foot/trunk sagittal columns missing unless D-GT21-C01-2 chooses otherwise, and keep source pelvis_tilt/list/rotation under source names. Joint angles, vertical force and anterior force/COP are unaffected. Return to the verifier for a pelvis-evidence re-check.

decisions.question: No pelvis forward/backward tilt derived from the authors' data matches marker tilt over treadmill strides. How should Georgia Tech 2021 pelvis tilt, and the thigh, shank, foot and trunk angles built on it, be handled?

options.label: Leave them missing
options.consequence: Five segment-angle columns are empty; the authors' pelvis angles are kept under their own names; joint angles are unaffected. Least adapter work. Reversible.

options.label: Authors' pelvis orientation with heading removed, flagged unvalidated
options.consequence: Fills the five columns from the authors' model. It disagrees with marker tilt on treadmill strides and agrees only partly overground. Adapter change. Reversible.

options.label: Tilt from the pelvis markers directly
options.consequence: Fills pelvis tilt independently of the authors' model. Its zero sits about 17 deg from the model pelvis, and the segment angles would mix marker and model references. Largest adapter change. Reversible.

decisions.cost_of_waiting: Pilots can run; the five segment-angle columns are not releasable.
decisions.why: Neither source-derived tilt is validated at the stride level on treadmill, and the marker route mixes references, so publishing nothing avoids releasing an unverified angle until the treadmill disagreement is explained.
decisions.check: Verification sheet, third figure, treadmill panel: neither coloured line follows the black marker tilt.

decisions.question: How should Georgia Tech 2021 sideways ground force and centre of pressure be published?

options.label: Positive to the subject's right
options.consequence: Lab X signed by the measured walking direction on straight lab-Z cycles; X-direction and unclear cycles stay missing. Sign rule in the adapter. Reversible.

options.label: Positive outward for each leg
options.consequence: As A with the left leg mirrored, matching the name 'lateral'. Sign rule and mirror. Reversible.

options.label: Lab axis only
options.consequence: Canonical sideways columns stay missing; measured lab +X kept under a lab-axis name. Rename columns. Reversible.

decisions.option_order: Most sideways values published first; ties broken by less adapter work.
decisions.cost_of_waiting: Pilots can still run; GT21 sideways columns are not releasable until chosen.
decisions.why: Our data spec does not define a sideways sign, so filling it for one dataset would set a cross-dataset convention by default; A or B can follow once the spec defines lateral.
decisions.check: Sideways decision sheet, diagram: lab +X at the right foot points outward in one walking direction and inward in the other.
